verdicts.title: Organizing for future war and warfare: Complexity as ‘folk theory’ in NATO policy
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Geopolitical and societal changes are increasingly narrated using the concept of complexity. In a range of policy contexts, from climate to finance and peacekeeping to defence and security, complexity is often prominent. This article explores the contemporary expressions of complexity in defence and security scholarship and policy.
